1 · Who the site is for

Someone who has tried classes or physio, and still hurts.

“My back has gone again. I’ve done the classes and the exercises the physio gave me. Nobody has told me why it keeps happening.”

A typical first visitor (illustration, not a real quote)

How they feel arriving

Tired of being told what to do. Wary of another class. Hoping someone will finally look at the whole picture.

What they’re checking

  • Is this different from what I’ve tried?
  • Is she properly qualified?
  • What does it cost, and what happens first?
  • Is it near me?

Pranic Healing clients matter too. They already find you; this site is for the people who don’t yet.
